objective: Incremental multi-season historical backtest using only information demonstrably available before kickoff.

priority_order: other Radar leagues with sufficient verified coverage
historical_perimeter.required_split: chronological development then frozen temporal holdout

repository_inventory.note: Four completed Allsvenskan regular seasons are normalized. Source kickoff time has no documented timezone, so UTC is not inferred and rolling features must use strictly prior dates.

quarantined_evidence.reason: Recent prospective movement snapshot; not a multi-season historical dataset.
Single-fixture proof with insufficient player identity/sample for player-prop inference.
Operational audit evidence is not a substitute for a frozen multi-season historical development/holdout dataset.
The first Norway build split Ham-Kam and HamKam, dropped 30 regular 2023 fixtures and produced a 15-team season. Its metrics are invalid and were replaced after identity correction.

work_completed: Repository historical inventory completed without promoting prospective 2026 snapshots into the historical sample.
Created a dedicated historical anti-hindsight contract separate from the operational Radar.
Created a machine-readable source manifest with acceptance gates and missing-block states.
Hardened TRUE OPEN/FIRST_SEEN distinction for historical MMS tests.
Hardened temporal development/holdout freeze and post-kickoff outcome-join boundary.
Blocked model metrics and threshold tuning until a verified Sweden multi-season source block exists.
Materialized Football-Data Sweden snapshot with 3,526 source rows across 2012-2026.
Profiled zero missing required fields, zero duplicate fixture keys, zero inconsistent outcomes and zero unparsed dates.
Frozen latest four completed seasons 2022-2025 before holdout evaluation.
Excluded four cross-division promotion/relegation playoff rows, yielding 960 regular-season fixtures.
Frozen temporal split: 2022-2024 development (720), 2025 holdout (240).
Established de-vigged external average closing-market holdout benchmark without relabelling it GoldBet.
Made historical workflow commit regeneration safe against concurrent operational pushes.
Built leakage-safe Sweden pre-match features with date-batch updates: Elo, prior-five form/goal balance, home-away PPG and prior-opponent Elo.
Froze multinomial training on 2022-2024 and evaluated ELO_ONLY, ELO_PLUS_FORM and FULL_STRUCTURAL once on untouched 2025 holdout.
Added 10,000-draw paired match-bootstrap diagnostics without changing model parameters after holdout inspection.
Found a clear structural-model gain over the naive development prior, but no demonstrated gain over external de-vigged closing odds.
Found no reliable incremental benefit from form/goal balance/home-away/opponent-quality beyond Elo on the same holdout.
Acquired and profiled Football-Data Norway with 3,518 Eliteserien rows across 2012-2026; zero missing required fixture/result fields, duplicates, inconsistent outcomes or unparsed dates.
Detected and quarantined an invalid first Norway sample caused by the same club being split as Ham-Kam and HamKam.
Canonicalized 50 Ham-Kam identity occurrences to HamKam before fixture eligibility and feature construction, restoring 16 teams and 240 regular matches in every 2022-2025 season.
Excluded six genuine promotion/relegation playoff fixtures, yielding 960 regular Eliteserien rows.
Replicated the Sweden v1 feature specification and fixed hyperparameters on Norway: 2022-2024 development (720), untouched 2025 holdout (240).
Norway structural variants beat the development-prior baseline, while external de-vigged closing odds significantly beat all structural variants.
Across Sweden and Norway, no reliable incremental OOS benefit from the full form/venue/opponent-quality bundle beyond Elo was established.
Completed frozen pooled Sweden-Norway comparison on 480 untouched 2025 holdout fixtures with no holdout retuning.
Confirmed pooled ELO_ONLY improvement over development priors: Brier gain 0.05956 and log-loss gain 0.08185; stratified paired 95% intervals exclude zero.
Confirmed pooled external closing-market superiority over ELO_ONLY and ELO_PLUS_FORM; paired Brier/log-loss intervals exclude zero.
Confirmed no reliable pooled increment from form or the full structural bundle beyond Elo.
Measured significant market-benchmark predictability drift: external closing loss is higher in Sweden than Norway; 95% independent-bootstrap intervals exclude zero for Brier and log-loss.
Audited draw probabilities: no system top-picks D, but ELO_ONLY mean draw probability 21.65% closely matches the 20.63% observed rate.
Hardened the cross-league publisher so generated evidence is rebased and committed quickly instead of rerunning the expensive bootstrap during every push race.

full_vs_development_prior.interpretation: FULL_STRUCTURAL improves the naive prior on this holdout; match-bootstrap intervals exclude zero.

full_vs_external_market_close.interpretation: Point estimates favor external close; intervals cross zero, so neither superiority claim is established.

incremental_full_vs_elo_only.interpretation: No reliable incremental improvement beyond Elo.

paired_uncertainty_summary.limitation: Match-level diagnostic only; one league-season holdout and schedule dependence prevent operational promotion.

elo_plus_form_vs_market.interpretation: Negative intervals exclude zero: the external closing benchmark has lower loss than the best structural variant on Norway 2025.

full_vs_elo_only.interpretation: No reliable incremental gain from the full structural bundle.

paired_uncertainty_summary.limitation: Paired match bootstrap remains diagnostic; closing is an external near-kickoff benchmark, not a GoldBet TRUE OPEN signal or executable historical strategy.

draw_diagnostic.interpretation: Draw probability level is broadly calibrated for Elo variants; zero argmax selections do not imply zero draw probability. Accuracy must not substitute probabilistic calibration.

league_drift.interpretation: The 2025 Sweden market benchmark is materially harder/less predictable than Norway; no causal league explanation is claimed.

ablation_plan.promotion_rule: No module becomes an autonomous edge without replicable OOS improvement.

next_increment.priority: Acquire and profile Denmark as the next comparable four-season Radar league, preserving Sweden/Norway v1 specifications and identity gates.
next_increment.cross_league_lane: Keep Sweden/Norway holdouts frozen; no further parameter or confidence-threshold tuning.
next_increment.market_lane: Retain external closing odds as a benchmark only and segment results by league.
next_increment.mms_lane: GoldBet historical TRUE OPEN remains unavailable; no OPEN-to-CLOSE or threshold test is authorized.

promoted_rules: RESEARCH_ONLY: retain ELO_ONLY as the structural historical benchmark for subsequent leagues; it improves naive priors on Sweden, Norway and the pooled frozen holdout. This is not an operational betting rule.
rejected_rules: Sweden v1: reject the claim that prior-five form, goal balance, venue PPG and opponent-quality features add a reliable OOS gain beyond Elo; paired 2025 intervals include zero.
Cross-league Sweden+Norway v1: reject promotion of the full prior-five form/goal-balance/venue/opponent-quality bundle beyond Elo; neither 2025 holdout provides a reliable paired improvement.
Norway v1: reject any claim that a structure-only 1X2 model matches the information in the external closing market; the closing benchmark has significantly lower Brier and log-loss.
Pooled Sweden+Norway: reject promotion of prior-five form as an incremental module beyond Elo; paired intervals include zero.
Pooled Sweden+Norway: reject the full structural bundle as an improvement over Elo; point estimates are worse and paired intervals include zero.
historical_method_changes: Structural fixture eligibility separated from market-price eligibility.
Latest four completed Allsvenskan seasons frozen as 2022-2025.
Cross-division playoffs excluded from regular-season comparability.
External average closing odds accepted only as de-vigged market benchmark.
Paired match-bootstrap uncertainty added as a diagnostic after the frozen one-shot holdout evaluation; model and hyperparameters were not changed.
Team identity canonicalization is now an eligibility gate: league-season team counts and schedules must be reconciled before any OOS metric is accepted.
Superseded OOS reports caused by identity errors must remain explicitly quarantined rather than silently overwritten.
Classwise probability calibration is mandatory when an outcome is never the argmax; top-pick accuracy alone cannot diagnose probabilistic failure.
League-specific drift must be reported before pooling closing-market benchmarks.
Expensive historical evidence generation is separated from fast race-safe publication to avoid interference from operational feed commits.
rule_decisions.note: Elo is promoted only as a research baseline. No betting threshold, GoldBet signal or operational Radar rule is promoted.
